shorts_rules: Name the core subject or state the primary paradox within the first 3 seconds to clear up any ambiguity immediately.
Keep script pacing between 2.5 to 3.0 words per second to match the viewer's natural digestion speed for complex science topics.
Make abstract numbers tangible by comparing them to everyday objects like pickup trucks, football fields, or transit times.
Maintain our fixed duration limits strictly: keep news shorts between 20 to 25 seconds, and big question shorts between 30 to 35 seconds.
End every script with a fresh, natural sign-off that mentions Tomorrowly without repeating previous catchphrases.
Ensure all technical and scientific claims are 100% factual while explaining them using simple, everyday language.
Structure the mid-section as a step-by-step breakdown or progressive scaling sequence to maintain high dopamine and retention.
Design the final sentence to either loop seamlessly back into the opening hook or leave a powerful lingering paradox.
visual_sound_notes: Use high-end 3D cutaway animations synchronized 1:1 with narration to instantly clarify invisible or complex mechanisms.
Keep cuts frequent (2.5 to 3.5 cuts per 10 seconds) to sustain visual momentum without inducing motion sickness.
Display large, bold captions (1-3 words at a time, centered lower-third) with distinct color highlights on critical keywords.
Layer a subtle, tense cinematic ambient synth bed beneath a front-and-center crisp voiceover, punctuated by crisp mechanical sound effects.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine viral hone wali shorts mein yeh baat samne aayi hai ke shuru ke 3 sehon mein hi asal topic ya hairat-angez sawal wazeh kar dena sab se zaroori hai. Hamari apni videos mein 5 se 8 seconds ke darmiyan log drop ho rahe hain, is liye hamein apni opening lines ko mazeed taiz aur dilchasp banana hoga. 3D cutaways aur real-world comparisons (jaise cheezon ko aam cheezon se compare karna) viewers ko aakhir tak bandh kar rakhte hain. Hamein apni fixed timing (news ke liye 20-25 seconds aur big questions ke liye 30-35 seconds) par sakhti se amal karna chahiye. Aakhir mein ek behtar aur naya sign-off istemal karen jo Tomorrowly ka zikr kare aur comments ko barha sake.
